_readme: Which adapter supplies each signal. Adapters live in scripts/rates/sources/.
'manual' offers nothing, so the pipeline is a no-op and the file stays whatever a
human last set with `npm run rates:set` / `npm run rates:cpi`.
FX: switch "adapter" to "tgju" to pull the free-market USD close automatically.
That endpoint is verified reachable from cloud runners but is undocumented and
carries no published usage policy, so opting in is the maintainer's call.
CPI: no adapter exists. amar.org.ir and cbi.ir refuse connections from non-Iranian
IPs, so CPI is maintained by hand. See docs in the v1.4 rates report.
